responsibility: Defines the shared result and scanner-control types used by the gm2 ISO string-conversion modules. It standardizes conversion outcome codes, scanner input classifications, and the ScanState procedure type that finite-state lexical scanners such as whole- and real-number parsers exchange while validating textual numeric input.
same_name_distinction: This is the substantive definition module for shared conversion/scanner types, where ConvResults, ScanClass, and the ScanState procedure type are declared; the same-stem ConvTypes.mod is only the required empty implementation companion.
